_readme: Seed list of US federal benefit programs for the hackathon demo. Each entry lists the OFFICIAL source pages to feed into Writer's Knowledge Graph (download the PDFs/HTML from these before the hackathon in case Wi-Fi is bad) and the deterministic eligibility rule id implemented in server/rules.py. VERIFY all thresholds against the live .gov source before the demo — poverty guidelines update every January and some figures here are illustrative placeholders.

programs.name: SNAP (Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program)
documents_needed: Proof of residency (utility bill or lease)
Proof of income (pay stubs, last 30 days)
Social Security numbers for all household members
Proof of expenses (rent, utilities, childcare) if claiming deductions

programs.name: Medicaid
programs.notes: Eligibility threshold varies significantly by state and expansion status. Treat as 'likely eligible, state rules apply' rather than a hard yes/no.

programs.name: SSI (Supplemental Security Income)
documents_needed: Medical evidence of disability (if applying on disability/blindness basis)

programs.name: LIHEAP (Low Income Home Energy Assistance Program)
documents_needed: Proof of income (last 12 months or last 3 months, varies by state)
Social Security numbers for household members

programs.name: WIC (Women, Infants, and Children)
documents_needed: Proof of income (or proof of SNAP/Medicaid/TANF enrollment for automatic eligibility)
Proof of pregnancy or child's age/immunization record

programs.name: EITC (Earned Income Tax Credit)
documents_needed: Filed or to-be-filed federal tax return
Social Security numbers for filer, spouse, and qualifying children

programs.name: Housing Choice Voucher Program (Section 8)
documents_needed: Photo ID for all adult household members
Proof of income for all household members
Proof of citizenship or eligible immigration status
programs.notes: Local PHAs often have waitlists and their own income limits (30/50/80% of Area Median Income). Treat result as 'likely income-eligible; check local PHA waitlist status'.
